input CLK;

  input [9:0] xAxis; 
  input [9:0] yAxis; 
  input [9:0] zAxis;

  reg [2:0] LED; 
  always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) 
  if (RST == 1'b1)

  else

  if (SW == 2'b00) begin

  LED <= 3'b010;
